description: Update a form's settings: name, notification recipients, active state, and server-side field validation. Requires an API key (call instant_provision first, or set FORMSLIST_API_KEY). Paid-plan fields (redirect_url, allowed_domains) return an upgrade message and upgrade_url to relay to the user instead of failing.

email_notifications.description: Turn submission emails on or off

notification_emails.description: Who receives each submission by email. An ARRAY, e.g. ["owner@site.com"]

redirect_url.description: PAID: where visitors land after submitting

value.description: Length for min/max_length, regex for pattern

validation_rules.description: Server-side validation; failing submissions get 422 with per-field errors. null clears.

name: update_form
